name: pyrax-web-fuzz
description: Coverage-guided (Jazzer.js) fuzzing of the untrusted-input parsers/verifiers in the PYRAX web portals: SigV4/ListObjectsV2 XML parsing, HMAC announce-ingest verification, announce-body validation, OTP code parsing, release-feed/manifest parsing, tunnel-relay Host-header routing + agent-JSON dispatch, and the tunnel-relay server-side masked WebSocket frame decoder (length-cap / fatal OOM guard). Harnesses import the REAL production parsers (never reimplementations).
